await page.evaluate('async () => {\n  const rows=[]; const counts=[];\n  for (let p=1;p<=10;p++){\n    const html=await (await fetch(\'?page=\'+p)).text();\n    const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,\'text/html\');\n    const trs=[...d.querySelectorAll(\'table tbody tr, table tr\')].filter(tr=>tr.querySelectorAll(\'td\').length);\n    counts.push(trs.length);\n    for(const tr of trs){const c=[...tr.querySelectorAll(\'td\')].map(t=>t.textContent.trim()); rows.push(c);}\n  }\n  const ids=new Set(rows.map(r=>r[0]));\n  const customers=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[1]))]; const statuses=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[3]))];\n  const m=rows.filter(r=>r[1]===\'Northwind\'&&r[3]===\'overdue\');\n  const cents=m.reduce((s,r)=>s+Math.round(parseFloat(r[2].replace(/[$,]/g,\'\'))*100),0);\n  return {counts,total:rows.length,unique:ids.size,customers,statuses,m,sum:cents/100};\n}');
```
